points.point: Is there an approval link to send the client?
points.sentence: Blotato does not have a built-in approval-link feature in the web app.

points.point: How to hold one post back for edits
points.sentence: To pause a post for edits, open the three-dot menu and choose Move to Drafts. Publish or reschedule once you are satisfied.

verdict.reason: The post-approval entry states there is no approval-link feature and explains how to pause a post for edits via Move to Drafts, covering both questions.
